scope.bounded: The single alumina pin: O5.000 h6 shaft, 95.00 overall, O8.00 x 3.00 foot flange. Datum: Z=0 at the foot end.
scope.modelling_conventions: The R50 tip crown (0.063 mm sagitta over O5), the R1.0 blends (LP-D05/D08) and the 90 deg foot seat cone (LP-D09) are ground features deferred to the drawing, per the established edge-feature convention. Straightness, finish and set-matching (LP-D03/D10/D11/D12) are inspection callouts.
scope.open_state: No dependency on ECR-Q-011, the path-length item, or CP-02.

material.name: Aluminum Oxide
material.source: spec/05 section 6 - 99.8% alumina, selected; LP-10 forbids metal

requirements.statement: O5.000 h6 shaft, 95.00 overall - guide fit in the SEWCP-601 bushing, He sealing surface, Paschen-safe.
O8.00 x 3.00 foot flange at the actuator end - seat and retention; the highest-bending-moment section.
No metal may contact the wafer backside - the pin is monolithic 99.8% alumina; sapphire is the qualified alternate.
Centreless-ground shaft for LP-D03 straightness and Ra 0.2; crown and blends ground, no undercut; pins supplied in matched sets of 3 (LP-D12).

interfaces.nature: O5.000 h6 in the O5.60 bushing bore - deliberately loose lateral support (verified plate side)
